cn_steps: `LinuxArm64TargetPlatform`（Linux Arm64 Target Platform）：它提供某个目标平台/设备的支持（平台识别、设置、打包、设备探测）。位于 `Developer`，构建规则 `Developer/Linux/LinuxArm64TargetPlatform/LinuxArm64TargetPlatform.Build.cs`。直接依赖 3 个模块：`Core`、`DesktopPlatform`、`TargetPlatform`。
部署：`LinuxArm64TargetPlatform` 开发者/工具模块，供编辑器或命令行使用，不要当游戏运行时依赖。
怎么用：平台能力会在切换目标平台或打包时自动带出，通常不需要在游戏模块里显式依赖；只有写平台相关原生代码时才直接 include。

依赖：在 `YourModule.Build.cs` 加入 `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "LinuxArm64TargetPlatform" });`；对外暴露 `LinuxArm64TargetPlatform` 类型用 Public，仅内部调用用 Private，然后 Generate Project Files 并编译。
调用：包含其 `Public/` 头文件以使用导出类型；模块由引擎/插件系统自动加载，通常无需手动 `LoadModulePtr`（仅懒加载时才用 `FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked`）。
en_steps: `LinuxArm64TargetPlatform` (Linux Arm64 Target Platform): it provides support for a target platform/device (detection, settings, packaging, device probing). Located under `Developer`; build rule `Developer/Linux/LinuxArm64TargetPlatform/LinuxArm64TargetPlatform.Build.cs`. It directly depends on 3 modules: `Core`, `DesktopPlatform`, `TargetPlatform`.
Placement: `LinuxArm64TargetPlatform` is a developer/tool module for editor or CLI use; not a game runtime dependency.
How to use: platform support is pulled in automatically when targeting/packaging for that platform; you rarely depend on it directly — only include it for platform-specific native code.

Depend: in `YourModule.Build.cs` add `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "LinuxArm64TargetPlatform" });`. Use Public when exposing `LinuxArm64TargetPlatform` types, Private if only calling it; then Generate Project Files and rebuild.

Call: include its `Public/` headers to use exported types; the engine/plugin system loads the module automatically — no manual `LoadModulePtr` needed (use `FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked` only for lazy loading).
